about_the_game:
Save the world of Naica

Naica started in the Age of Golcondite, also known as the Genesis age by most denizens, during this time the crystalline form of this world was born, cold and barren. Naica felt alone, and in her loneliness she began to dance to warm herself up, with this dance she has created Light and gave her the name Naide - The Goddess of Order which helped her warm her cold exterior. As the saying goes, there cannot be Light without Darkness, as soon as the first dance finished Icaon - The God of Chaos was born in tandem, helping balance the extreme heat of the light.

The Rebisphene Age was the consequence of the constant quarrels between Naide and Icaon, both yearning for the attention of their mother, also known as the age of Discord, which created the First Ones - the first proper inhabitants of Naica. They split their loyalties between Naide and Icaon based off their respective promises which only split the world even further. As the ages passed, and quarrels continued, the First Ones became clustered, the most devoted ones still continued to bicker, but the rest became what we now recognize as Naicalites. Their variety came from adapting to their living environments which shifted throughout the ages, hence why even though they share the same ancestors, most Naicalites look nothing alike.

Create and Customize Your Hero

Choose from one of four native Naica races, the dexterous Vulpian, the mighty Cerbali, scaly Ophimanders or the sneaky Azralians. Take the path of the Warrior, Ranger or Mage, each with 3 distinct playstyles that you can specialize in. Some of which include the Crusher Warrior, the Assassin Ranger or a Chilling Mage. Express yourself by mixing and matching various talents to create a build that is perfect for you!

Take up arms against the invading dark forces of the land and equip yourself with enchanted gear from the Age of Verberyl, a time of re-discovery and exploration, which allowed the Naicalites to flourish after the Age of Discord. Harness the magical power within various armor and weapons, and look great while doing it!

Assist Your Fellow Naicalites

You will encounter many people throughout your adventures in Naica, each with their own personality and quests for you to help them with. It is up to you to help heal the world through good-faith actions and helping your fellow Naicalites during your Journey.

They will help you explore the various zones across the world, and guide you on the path to becoming a powerful ally in their fight against the dark forces that have invaded and corrupted Naica.

Overcome the Hardest of Challenges

During your adventures, you will encounter powerful enemies, treacherous locations and even remnants of the old world in the form of Dungeons. Gather up your party of at least two allies and clear these Dungeons for great rewards! The runes you obtain can be used to help you progress further than ever before.

With each Dungeon level you clear, the enemies will become stronger, increasing their tenacity and amount of pain they inflict, but remember, the deeper you go, the better the rewards will be!

Everything that Naica has to Offer

  • Level 40 Cap

  • 3 unique classes with 9 different playstyles

  • With 12 gear sets tailored to each playstyle obtainable in Dungeons and through spending of Ancient Runes

  • 7 beautiful zones filled to the brim with interesting NPCs, various enemies and bosses to encounter

  • With more than 100 quests to complete

  • 3 dungeons which can be cleared endlessly with increasing levels of difficulty and higher rewards in turn

  • Dungeons scale infinitely (currently up to Level 20)

  • 3 battleground arenas for all PvP enjoyers

  • World PvP as well as PvP exclusive gear that will enhance your combat prowess

  • A transmogrification system that allows you to exchange gear pieces without changing your overall look

  • The Gem shop where you can obtain cosmetics and certain conveniences like faster gathering

  • An alchemical talent tree which allows you to customize the effects of your potions

short_description: Naica is a 8bit Fantasy cross-platfrom MMORPG where you take on the role of a lowly adventurer trying to assist those in peril. Fight, collect or explore what the world of Naica has to offer, secrets lie behind every corner. The world needs your help adventurer, will you answer the call?
